Full local suite green: **14368 passed**, 63 skipped, 173 deselected, 1 xfailed, 0 failures (53m44s, `pytest -m 'not integration and not external' --ignore=tests/external`).

Live-Jira safety: `JIRA_URL`/`JIRA_USER`/`JIRA_API_TOKEN` WERE present in the shell, so the run was launched with them explicitly scrubbed (`env -u JIRA_API_TOKEN -u JIRA_URL -u JIRA_USER`) and with `tests/external` explicitly ignored on top of the `not external` marker deselection — no reliance on auto-skip. No live-mutating Jira test ran.

One reported ERROR, root-caused as self-inflicted and NOT a regression: `test_repo_isolation_guard.py::test_commit_guard_fails_explicitly_when_head_times_out` reported `Test moved the repo HEAD (9bfe4b428a -> f3ef020cb5)`. That is the session-level guard detecting MY OWN `git commit` (f3ef020cb5), made in this worktree while the suite was still running so CI could start in parallel. Re-run against a stable HEAD: 12 passed. CI checks out a fixed ref and does not commit mid-run, so it cannot recur there.
